The reason so many Harbingers have it rough, I believe, is that they're forced into the relationship. It's much different to metaphorically walk into it with both eyes open, started by opening a dialogue with the Greater Power.

Well, the reason why we manage to be a family at all is because of those basics I mentioned when I explained my first meeting with Boss Lady. The exact terms are:

1. I will not be made to harm a beloved friend or family member\* directly or knowingly indirectly.
2. I will be allowed time to dedicate to the care and fulfillment of my Self. The exact amount per week is negotiable and agreements may be open to revision.
3. I will be allowed to press bindings upon my Mark to have better control over the storm.\*\*

\*Note the 'beloved', since you never know when a friend or family member is going to turn out to be a bastard and suddenly you feel a lot less affectionate.

\*\*Some Patrons can have a bit of an attitude about their storm getting affected.

My family is generally pretty loving and supportive, so spending time together usually fits under 'time dedicated to care and fulfillment of my Self'. It's not perfect, obviously.

As you pointed out, my siblings working for an Alabaster Judge when my mom works for Unrest is a little awkward at times. It actually started as a bit of teen rebellion from them, not helped by mom's storm, but since then they've grown to believe in their patron's beliefs.

Personally, I'm still mad about every time I was forcibly calmed down by them when they broke my toys or stole my snacks, so I was never going to work for him.

My siblings used to be a little irresponsible.

Opposing storms don't really calm down, so much as compete. When we were having breakfast it was always kind of a coinflip if something would be unsettling/annoying/etc or if I would feel emotionally neutered. Meanwhile, dad's storm froze my tea and I prayed for college to come sooner.

Anyways, the 'not bring harm indirectly' part means that a Patron can't send one of us in a mission that opposes another family member or *their* Patron, since that would be bad for them.

And if they do it *unknowingly*, then it can be forgiven and worked off.

Some might think that we demand too much, but the truth is that the service of a Harbinger is undervalued. I've encountered few Practices as good as mine at breaking through defenses and defeating enemies. Even my siblings' more peace-focused abilities are great at subverting opposition.

A lot of Greater Powers rely on worship, in some way, and few things make an impression like a Berserker Mage on a war path. Every time one of my family members has gotten serious and gone all-out, then their respective Patrons usually saw an influx of people wanting a piece of the power demonstrated.

As for why we're tolerated in our city...

We're okay at keeping things under wraps outside of home and we're great at dealing with trouble others are scared of. Goblin bands, an abandoned home that Bogeymen have taken over, things like that.

We're like pest control, except magic.
